settings.deniedPaths.hint: One glob per line: .env, .env.*, *.pem, node_modules. Empty - do not deny. Lines starting with # are comments.
settings.deniedCommands.label: Denied commands
settings.deniedCommands.hint: Binary names for run_command, one per line: rm, curl, bash, docker. Empty - do not deny by name (eval, git write, and package install stay blocked). Lines starting with # are comments.
settings.secretPatterns.label: Secret patterns (regexp)
settings.secretPatterns.hint: One JS regexp per line. Matches in tool output become [REDACTED]. Empty - no redaction. Invalid regexps are skipped.
settings.loggingEnabled.label: Write logs
settings.loggingEnabled.hint: Off by default. Output channels Gen LLM and Gen Agent, plus llm.log and agent.log. Disk writes are async and do not block requests.
